summary: The PR addresses the issue of allowing ModelForm meta to specify formfield_callback correctly. It introduces a more comprehensive resolution by considering multiple sources for the callback.

issues.description: The introduction of new files (edge_cases.py and reproduce.py) seems unrelated to the core fix in models.py. These files appear to be for testing or demonstration purposes and should likely be part of the test suite or documentation rather than the main codebase.
The new print statements in edge_cases.py and reproduce.py are not idiomatic for production code. They should be replaced with proper logging or assertions if these scripts are intended for testing.
